archetype: A mono-red Goblin go-wide deck whose commander turns one-target cantrips into one copy per creature; storm is a second, thinner route. deck-audit establishes no archetype, so base targets apply. Two of the three declared targets are commander_gated false, so the deck has plans without Zada.
verdict: It functions: every mana axis is at target and the turn-3 land drop lands 0.909. What limits it is the multiplier, not the spells. Zada arrives at mean turn 4.248 onto a goldfish board of 1.906 bodies at turn 4 and 2.437 at turn 5, and the goldfish kill lands by turn 8 in 0.255 of games. Both logged losses (001, 002) were openers with no cheap Goblin. Protecting Zada (Swiftfoot Boots alone) is an open question, not a proven limit, until the table's removal is known.

engine.declared: Bodies set the copy count: Zada copies a one-target cantrip or pump once per other creature. Storm (rituals plus Grapeshot, Empty the Warrens or Haze of Rage) is the second route, and it also runs off bodies through Brightstone Ritual and Battle Hymn.

components.reading: Cast by turn 6 in 0.93 of goldfish games, mean turn 4.248. She arrives on time. What she arrives into is the problem.

The declared group is five cards, at 0.665 overall and 0.528 by turn 6. The deck actually has 11 body cards at mana value 2 or less: the five above plus Goblin Bushwhacker, Goblin Lackey, Impulsive Pilferer, Conspicuous Snoop, Grenzo and Rundvelt Hordemaster. Goblin Negotiation is left out because it only makes tokens off excess damage. Kher Keep and Dwarven Mine are land bodies and are not counted. The corpus prices 10 copies at 54% of openers, so close to half of openers start with no cheap body. Both logged games were in that half.

0.702 assembled, 0.545 by turn 6. Witch's Mark and Daring Discovery can also target only Zada and are not declared, so the true count is higher. Its by-turn-6 rate is only 0.017 above the declared fodder group's, so by presence alone the two cannot be ranked. The case that bodies bind rests on how many are on board when Zada lands (1.906 at turn 4) and on the two logs, not on this comparison.
The thinnest group by size. Paired with four rituals it gives the storm target 0.345, and 0.2 by turn 6. It is the ceiling route, not the median one.

Same target as the payoff group. Ancestors' Aid (an untapped Treasure), Skirk Prospector and Storm-Kiln Artist also make mana mid-turn and are not declared. Great Train Heist is not one of them: its Treasure enters tapped.

open_questions.question: Widen the fodder target to all 11 cheap-body cards (add Goblin Bushwhacker, Goblin Lackey, Impulsive Pilferer, Conspicuous Snoop, Grenzo, Rundvelt Hordemaster) and re-measure, with and without Goblin Instigator and Hordeling Outburst. Also run a keep rule that requires one of them.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The declared group of five understates the deck's own bodies, so 0.665 is not the logged mulligan criterion. The fodder adds are sized off a figure nobody has measured.

open_questions.question: Does a storm-copied Spreading Insurrection, with Goblin Bombardment or Broadside Bombardiers out, turn each stolen creature into damage and widen the board Zada and Battle Hymn count? And how often does it come up?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is a five-drop that Zada cannot copy, but it is also a body source and a removal line in this 99. Whether it is a cut depends on that line, so the cut was withdrawn.

open_questions.question: With Frontline Heroism on the battlefield, cast a spell targeting only Zada: does the Heroism Soldier exist in time to count as an 'other creature' for Zada's copies, and does Heroism's own copy also get copied?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Frontline Heroism is already in the 99. If it widens Zada's copy count by one per spell, it is a body source the fodder analysis has not counted.

open_questions.question: Witch's Mark and Daring Discovery cast targeting only Zada: does each copy make its own discard-draw-two or discover 4?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If so, both belong in the ignition group, and the card-advantage reading gets stronger.

open_questions.question: How much targeted removal on the commander does the pilot's actual table run, and when?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The corpus's insurance test depends on the table's removal. The log does not record what was aimed at Zada, so protection stays open, and the Deflecting Swat add is conditional on the answer.

The goldfish has no blockers and no removal. It cannot price protection, and its bodies-by-turn figures are a ceiling.
The log has two entries, both losses, both on this decklist. The cheap-body finding repeats across them, but two games is a small base.
Goblin Burrows and Reliquary Tower are not proposed as cuts: both appear in checker-passed stack 012, and red sources are at target, so the old reason to cut Burrows no longer holds.

findings.note: Iteration 2. validate-diagnosis OK. Every figure still matches the current goldfish_metrics.json (sha c8651652…): Zada's mean cast turn 4.248, bodies 1.906 at T4 and 2.437 at T5, kill by T8 0.255, turn-3 land drop 0.909. Protection is now an open question rather than the 'second limit', which is what commander-insurance's decision test supports.

Prior mis-cited finding fixed: the cut now cites 'near zero in an aggressive one', the clause that fits the deck as described (axes[10] calls it aggro). The cards are named (Den of the Bugbear, Forgotten Cave, Hidden Volcano, Smoldering Crater, Spinerock Knoll), matching the audit. 'The goldfish always puts lands in untapped' is right: the model has no tapped state for lands. Calling it a weakness at 5 against near zero is what the source says. The cost is honestly scaled as small, and no cut is forced on it.
Now says Blasphemous Act also kills Zada and the engine's bodies, which is true by its oracle text ('13 damage to each creature').

Prior over-claim fixed. The verdict is adequate, the reading calls it open, and it cites the section's decision test plus the verbatim 'against light-interaction pods, skip the insurance, pay the tax, rebuild', both checked against the full strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance text. It is tied to open_questions[4]. This is a real correction, not a rewording: the verdict changed, and the Swat add is now conditional.
Prior contradicts-artifact finding fixed. The axis now says Snoop casts and pays ('You may cast Goblin spells from the top of your library'); only Lackey cheats from hand.
Now says Kher Keep and Dwarven Mine are land bodies that were excluded. The 11 cheap nonland bodies were re-enumerated from cards.json, and the hypergeometric 0.574 supports 'close to half'.

Prior over-claim fixed: 'not the binding group' is gone. It now says the 0.017 gap (0.545 against 0.528) cannot rank the two groups, and puts the bodies case on 1.906 at T4 plus the two logs, which is the evidence that actually exists.

Prior contradicts-artifact finding fixed. Great Train Heist is excluded because its Treasure enters tapped (oracle text 'create a tapped Treasure token'), and Ancestors' Aid's Treasure is correctly called untapped.
Unchanged and still scoped to the one commander_gated target. Mithril Coat and Deflecting Swat are both commander-legal and within identity per cards.csv.
Quest is unchanged. No stack references it (grepped 001–012). The flat +2/+0 matches its oracle text, and the cost is real.

Prior over-claim fixed. The cost now names the six colourless spells and the activated abilities (Siege-Gang, Pashalik, Moggcatcher, the utility lands, equip, encore) that Throne's 'monocolored spells of that color' mana cannot pay. All six spells are confirmed colourless in cards.json. Rating it contested stays fair.

Moggcatcher is painful, and the cost (tutor count halves; the only tutor that puts the Goblin onto the battlefield, repeatably) is real. The mana arithmetic is corrected to 6 with Ruby Medallion and 7 without. Its only mention in stack 012 is the checker's Human enumeration, so orphans_stack [] is correct. With Spreading Insurrection withdrawn, the list still carries a painful entry.
Goblin Instigator: a {1}{R} Goblin whose ETB makes a Goblin token. Legal and within identity. It closes the declared token-maker target, and 11→12 cheap bodies is correct (MV 2).

The prior Young Pyromancer finding is answered by REPLACING the card, not rewording it. Hordeling Outburst per cards.csv is a {1}{R}{R} sorcery, 'Create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens', red, commander-legal, not already in the decklist. Its tokens are Goblins, so the Brightstone, Prospector and Krenko-X claims hold, and the add no longer carries the Human defect the Moggcatcher cut is charged with. On `closes`: it is a token maker, the shape the 'Early token maker drawn' label names, and the why says outright that it reaches 0.665 only if added to the any_of (open_questions[0]). That disclosure is what the Cratermaker entry lacked. The why makes no MV≤2 claim, correctly, since it is MV 3. The quote 'stack the classes you want every game … tutor only the irreplaceable' is used in its context in strategy:deckbuilding.redundancy-vs-tutors, which is redundancy over tutoring.

Deflecting Swat is now conditional on open_questions[4], and it cites the section's own skip clause beside the hub clause. Its oracle text (free if you control a commander; redirect a target) matches the claim.
Soul-Guide Lantern is unchanged. 'Exile each opponent's graveyard' closes the one uncovered class, with the meta caveat quoted in context.

Prior over-claim on the Spreading Insurrection cut is handled by withdrawing the cut. The Threaten-plus-sacrifice line (Goblin Bombardment 'Sacrifice a creature', Broadside Bombardiers 'Sacrifice another creature') and the wider board for Zada and Battle Hymn are routed to resolve-stack instead of asserted. No unverified line is stated as fact.

Frontline Heroism (in the 99: 'Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 … then copy that spell') is now engaged, as an open timing question for resolve-stack and not a claim. This answers the omission flagged last round.

The Forge void, the goldfish ceiling and the absent recon are all stated. Not a finding, but for the record: stack 012's board includes the branch-only Hanweir Garrison. The Burrows and Reliquary gap remains a non-prescription.
